question: Should default non-heartbeat runs stop loading HEARTBEAT.md when heartbeat guidance is enabled, or should the current documented visibility stay and token savings remain opt-in?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the requested change would modify a documented default context contract rather than only repairing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Adopt on-demand default
options.body: Make default non-heartbeat runs skip HEARTBEAT.md before load/cache/injection, update docs, and add focused default/heartbeat regression tests.

options.title: Keep current default
options.body: Leave normal-run HEARTBEAT.md visibility as documented and rely on lightContext, isolated heartbeat sessions, or broader bootstrap controls for token reduction.

options.title: Fold into broader context policy
options.body: Defer this narrow behavior to the broader deterministic/tiered bootstrap design so one maintainer decision covers all session-type filtering rules.

recommendation.title: Adopt on-demand default
recommendation.body: Make default non-heartbeat runs skip HEARTBEAT.md before load/cache/injection, update docs, and add focused default/heartbeat regression tests.
